name: gpu_power_utilization_consistency
description: Checks whether bound GPU utilization and independent rack-power samples fell inside declared workload-state bands during a measurement window.

claim.text: The GPU utilization samples and independent rack-power samples for a bound node/rack pair fell inside the declared workload-state bands during the same measurement window.

declaration.hardware_class.probe: record declared hardware class for the consistency window
declaration.hardware_class.why: Without the declared hardware class, the receipt cannot bind the expected bands to a GPU capacity class.

declaration.window_start.probe: record the measurement window start in UTC
declaration.window_start.why: Without a window start, telemetry samples cannot be bounded to the asserted period.

declaration.window_end.probe: record the measurement window end in UTC
declaration.window_end.why: Without a window end, telemetry samples cannot be bounded to the asserted period.

declaration.expected_power_band_kw.min.probe: declare the minimum independent power band for the workload and hardware class
declaration.expected_power_band_kw.min.why: Without a lower power bound, idle-looking rack power cannot contradict a high-utilization workload claim.

declaration.expected_power_band_kw.max.probe: declare the maximum independent power band for the workload and hardware class
declaration.expected_power_band_kw.max.why: Without an upper power bound, anomalous rack power cannot be checked against the asserted workload state.

declaration.expected_gpu_utilization_pct.probe: declare the minimum GPU utilization band for the workload and hardware class
declaration.expected_gpu_utilization_pct.why: Without a lower utilization bound, the receipt cannot distinguish idle or lightly used GPUs from the asserted workload state.

declaration.expected_gpu_utilization_pct.probe: declare the maximum GPU utilization band for the workload and hardware class
declaration.expected_gpu_utilization_pct.why: Without an upper utilization bound, anomalous GPU telemetry cannot be checked against the asserted workload state.

gpu_utilization_window.node_id.probe: export GPU telemetry node_id for the consistency window
gpu_utilization_window.node_id.why: Without a node identifier, GPU telemetry cannot be bound to independent power evidence.

gpu_utilization_window.samples.probe: export DCGM or NVML utilization samples for the measurement window
gpu_utilization_window.samples.why: Without GPU utilization samples, the receipt cannot check the GPU-reported side of the consistency claim.

power_window.rack_id.probe: export independent power rack_id for the consistency window
power_window.rack_id.why: Without a rack identifier, independent power samples cannot be bound to the observed GPU node.

power_window.samples.probe: export BMC, PDU, SMBPBI, or rack power samples for the same measurement window
power_window.samples.why: Without independent power samples, the receipt cannot check the non-GPU telemetry side of the consistency claim.

power_window.provenance.custody_tier.probe: record the custody tier for the independent power evidence
power_window.provenance.custody_tier.why: Without a custody tier, the receipt cannot distinguish operator-supplied power files from facility, third-party, or lender-controlled evidence.

power_window.provenance.measurement_type.probe: record whether the power evidence is per-outlet, rack aggregate, or facility meter data
power_window.provenance.measurement_type.why: Without measurement granularity, the receipt cannot determine whether power evidence is attributable to the bound node/rack pair.

node_rack_binding.node_id.probe: provide node-to-rack binding for the observed GPU node
node_rack_binding.node_id.why: Without node-to-rack binding, utilization and power evidence may refer to different physical assets.

node_rack_binding.rack_id.probe: provide node-to-rack binding for the observed power rack
node_rack_binding.rack_id.why: Without node-to-rack binding, utilization and power evidence may refer to different physical assets.

node_rack_binding.binding_basis.probe: record the basis for node-to-rack binding
node_rack_binding.binding_basis.why: Without a binding basis, the receipt cannot distinguish a physical or facility map from a bare operator assertion.
